sevenFriendsIsA: Seven Friends is a small, calm place to stay close to the friends who matter most. By using it you agree to these simple terms.
youMustBeOld: You must be old enough to use online services on your own where you live.
useYourOwnAccount: Use your own account and give correct information. Keep your login safe: what happens on your account is your responsibility.
youHaveSevenSeats: You have seven seats for friends. Friends you put to sleep do not use a seat.
beKindToYour: Be kind to your friends. Do not use Seven Friends to:
harassThreatenOrScare: harass, threaten or scare anyone, or send what someone has told you they do not want;
sendAnythingIllegalOr: send anything illegal, or pictures, videos or messages of other friends that you have no right to share;
pretendToBeSomeone: pretend to be someone else, or send spam or advertisements;
breakOrOverloadThe: break or overload the service, or use it with robots or scripts.
yourMessagesPicturesVideos: Your messages, pictures, videos and voice messages are yours. You let the service store them and deliver them to the friends you send them to, and nothing else.
youAreResponsibleFor: You are responsible for what you send. A friend can save or copy what you send them: only send what you are happy for them to keep.
youCanDeleteYour: You can delete your messages, your friends and your account at any time. See
forWhatIsStored: for what is stored and how to delete it.
anAccountThatBreaks: An account that breaks these terms can be limited or closed. You can leave at any time by deleting your account.

doNotRelyOn: Do not rely on it for emergencies: use the phone for those.
